title: Futu Securities Fully Integrates Proprietary Licensed VATP, Pioneering Asia's First Self-Built Web2 + Web3 Ecosystem
summary: (Hong Kong, March 26, 2026) — Futu Holdings Limited ("Futu" or the "Group") (Nasdaq: FUTU) has reached a significant new milestone: its wholly-owned, self-built virtual asset trading platform (VATP), PantherTrade (Hong Kong) Limited (“PantherTrade”), has announced the commencement of full-scale licensed operations. PantherTrade is poised for imminent integration with Futu Securities, the Group’s retail brokerage platform in Hong Kong, providing essential infrastructure support such as virtual asset trade matching, asset custody, and technical solutions. Through this deep integration between PantherTrade and Futu Securities, the Group is set to launch synergistic dual-track operations for traditional finance and Web3 within a fully compliant regulatory framework.
